metadata.case_name: WONG SUK HA v. LI TSUN WING

injuries.description: Head injury (assault) - was struck on the head and fell backwards
source: was struck on the head and fell backwards, injuring her back on a hard object.

injuries.description: Spondylolisthesis of the 5th lumbar vertebra on the first sacral segment with 5mm forward slipping of the L-5 vertebral body on top of S-1.
source: spondylolisthesis of the 5th lumbar vertebra on the first sacral segment with 5mm forward slipping of the L-5 vertebral body on top of S-1.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Fracture or linear defect in the pars inter-articular of the 5th lumbar vertebra (spondylolysis).
source: a fracture or linear defect in the pars inter-articular of the 5th lumbar vertebra.

injuries.description: Condition necessitating decompression of the left L-5 nerve root (left L5 nerve root involvement / left sciatica).
source: operation for the decompression of the left L-5 nerve root and fusion of the L5-S1 posterially.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: low back pain and left sciatica
severe numbness and weakness of the left leg, as if the left leg was paralysed
could not turn in bed and felt considerable pain after standing for 5 or 10 minutes
unable to lie on her left buttock
marked spasms of the sacral spinalis muscle
could not sit longer than for an hour or two
needed supports for walking after discharge

treatments_received: surgical decompression of the left L-5 nerve root
facet joint injection of the lumbar spine

losses.description: Persistent low back pain, left sciatica and limited movement resulting in ongoing disability and impairment.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Had to employ a part-time servant to assist her for about two months after discharge.
Losing her chosen career as a traffic warden (retired on medical grounds).
Her ordinary activities of living are much restricted so that her enjoyment of life has been permanently marred.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Top end of the serious injury category or lower end of next category cited at $335,000
